items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And Maynard Ferguson. I really liked hanging around with that group. ... No actually it was a big band. It was a time that he and what’s his name, that was traveling with him then that was on the road together.
